name: @storytree/base-dev-loop
description: The base dev loop (ADR-1170 D1, ADR-1192 D1): the gate runner, its step interface and its results table; the scoped test runner (`pnpm test`: its scope, units, run table, rerun and leftovers, holding whatever lock its caller hands it); the worktree installer; and the merge-queue scripts CI calls (queue-verdict.mjs, land-enqueue.mjs). It runs in a user's project as in storytree's own, whose personal half (packages/dev-loop) wraps the gate and the test runner with its heavy-run lock and contributes its checks through the gate's step interface.
